neighbours.label: ' includes' / ' including' / ' include' introducing the members of a set (also ' like' as an example marker)
fire: The price of the tour includes meals and a local guide.
Common symptoms include fever, cough and tiredness.
The kit includes a hammer, two screwdrivers and a tape.
Many birds, including robins and finches, visit the garden.
The new menu will include several vegan dishes.
Her duties at the clinic included booking appointments.
The festival includes concerts, film screenings and talks.
Several countries, including Peru and Chile, signed the deal.
quiet: The price of the tour covers meals and a local guide.
Common symptoms are fever, cough and tiredness.
The kit contains a hammer, two screwdrivers and a tape.
Many birds, such as robins and finches, visit the garden.
The new menu will offer several vegan dishes.
Her duties at the clinic were booking appointments.
The festival features concerts, film screenings and talks.
Several countries, among them Peru and Chile, signed the deal.

notes: Card: include/includes/including 19 of top 32. Max 7.97 is small; 'such as' near misses may leak.
